title: Silver Strike Lodge #403 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, classic mountain design meets upscale comfort with rich hardwood floors, vaulted beamed ceilings, and a stunning stone fireplace anchoring the open-concept living space. The chef’s kitchen impresses with high-end Viking appliances and ample seating for gathering over meals or morning coffee. Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed for rest and privacy, including a tranquil primary suite with a king bed, fireplace, and spa-like bath. The cozy bunk room is perfect for kids or extra guests. With complimentary shuttle service, heated garage parking, and ski storage, Silver Strike #403 is the ultimate Deer Valley getaway for families and friends seeking both adventure and indulgence. Silver Strike Lodge #403 is a beautifully appointed, single-level condo tucked within the prestigious Empire Pass neighborhood of Deer Valley Resort. With three bedrooms and three-and-a-half bathrooms, this inviting alpine retreat comfortably accommodates up to eight guests. Ski-in/ski-out access via the Silver Strike Express Lift makes hitting the slopes effortless, while luxury amenities—including a fitness center, ski lounge, hot tub, and firepit—offer the perfect après-ski experience. After a day on the mountain, unwind with a glass of wine on the private balcony or relax fireside in the warm, lodge-style great room.
